title: India’s Cockroach Protests
gist: Video analysis page from Foreign Policy editor in chief Ravi Agrawal on India's 'cockroach protests'; the captured text has no transcript, only the headline plus a NATO-and-Ukraine cluster of FP coverage arguing NATO expansion brings valuable assets, NATO is splitting in two, and Ukraine finally has a theory of victory.

insights.claim: Foreign Policy editor in chief Ravi Agrawal devoted a July 2026 video analysis to India's 'cockroach protests', signaling a notable wave of domestic protest in India.
insights.speaker: Ravi Agrawal
insights.so_what: Domestic unrest is a political-risk input for India equities and the country's manufacturing-diversification story; details are not in the captured text.

insights.claim: Related Foreign Policy analysis by Luke McGee argues Washington should not fear NATO expansion because new allies bring powerful military assets, whatever Donald Trump thinks.
insights.speaker: Ravi Agrawal
insights.so_what: A stronger case for enlargement supports sustained European defense procurement demand.
insights.quote: New allies bring powerful assets—whatever Donald Trump thinks.

insights.claim: Foreign Policy columnist Emma Ashford argues that NATO is splitting in two.
insights.speaker: Ravi Agrawal
insights.so_what: A fracturing alliance implies Europe must self-fund more of its security, a structural tailwind for European defense budgets.

insights.claim: Foreign Policy's Christian Caryl assesses that Ukraine finally has a theory of victory, while questioning whether it will work.
insights.speaker: Ravi Agrawal
insights.so_what: A credible Ukrainian strategy affects the duration of the war and thus European energy and reconstruction trades.
insights.quote: Ukraine Finally Has a Theory of Victory. Will It Work?

insights.claim: Foreign Policy asks whether Ukraine's decentralized drone innovation is a blip or a revolution in military affairs.
insights.speaker: Ravi Agrawal
insights.so_what: If decentralized drone production is a lasting revolution, it reshapes demand toward cheap autonomous systems over legacy platforms.
insights.quote: Is Ukraine’s Decentralized Drone Innovation a Blip or a Revolution?
